summary: End-to-end verification of the College Intelligence Engine (backend + frontend). Backend: 8/8 new live-API regression tests pass (catalog returns exactly 4 score keys with label/inputs/method; batch POST /api/admin/nirf/intelligence -> job_id -> poll job to 'Completed' with stats.scored==stats.total==15; GET /api/admin/nirf/intelligence list has 15 rows, each top-level has scores+overall_index+overall_grade+fees+fees_source+cohort_size, each of the 4 scores has value(0-100)+grade+confidence+weight_basis+method+components[] with every component carrying label/raw_value/normalized_score/weight/contribution/source/direction; detail endpoint GET /api/admin/nirf/intelligence/{id} returns full per-score component breakdown; Academic Strength Patents component is available=false with a note and the score's weight_basis is renormalized to exactly 0.8; Transparency score has confidence=1.0 and value 0-100; PUT /api/admin/nirf/fees/{id} with fees=500000 then fees=50000 confirms VFM rises when fees drop (recompute path verified end-to-end with restore to original); POST /api/admin/nirf/documents/{id}/intelligence recomputes a single doc and returns all 4 scores). Bundled module pytest 23/23 (intelligence+normalization+extraction) still pass. Frontend: /admin/nirf/intelligence renders admin-intelligence-page with intel-table containing 15 institution rows (each with 4 colored score chips + overall column with grade); clicking intel-row-IR-E-I-1075 mounts intel-detail with all 4 score-card-* tiles + fees-editor; how-calculated-career_success expands calc-breakdown-career_success showing Component/Raw/Norm/Weight/Contribution columns plus a 'Composite (weighted avg)' total; how-calculated-academic_strength expands the breakdown and visibly shows the Patents row with the excluded note (weight basis 0.8); fees-editor flow (fees-edit -> fees-input='75000' -> fees-save) shows 'Fees updated · scores recomputed' toast and the VFM score in detail updates immediately (observed 81.8 AA -> 86.8 AAA on IIT Kanpur after lowering fees); intel-compute-btn present; data-testid='metrics-to-intelligence' on /admin/nirf/metrics navigates to /admin/nirf/intelligence; data-testid='intel-to-metrics' navigates back to /admin/nirf/metrics; regression: /admin/nirf and /admin/nirf/review still load.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminIntelligence.jsx pollJob (lines 38-51): same pattern as the previous admin pages — retries silently on error forever with a 2.5s delay and no max attempts. If a job_id is briefly 404 right after creation or the network flaps, the UI will spin indefinitely with no terminal error toast. Add a max-attempts cap (e.g. 60) and surface a user-visible error when reached.

AdminIntelligence.jsx: the fees-editor PUT and the row-click GET responses are not wrapped in try/catch with explicit error toasts in all branches — on 5xx the UI may silently fail. A failure toast on every axios .catch in this page (compute, list, detail, fees-save) would harden UX.

server.py /api/admin/nirf/fees/{document_id}: PUT accepts any positive integer for fees; consider a sanity ceiling (e.g. fees<=10_000_000) and a Pydantic validator to reject 0/negative payloads — currently a typo like 1 rupee would cohort-renormalise VFM in a way that could distort the leaderboard.

intelligence_engine.set_fees: each PUT triggers a full cohort recompute synchronously inside the request handler. For 15 rows this is fine (<2s observed), but if categories grow to 100+ institutions this PUT may exceed the ingress timeout. Consider returning the updated single record synchronously and dispatching the cohort-wide recompute to a background task (the catalog already has _spawn for this pattern).
AdminIntelligence.jsx FeesEditor: no client-side validation of the input — empty string, negative numbers, or 'abc' would be sent. The button click should be disabled until parseInt(value) > 0.

intelligence_engine indicative_fees: institution-type detection appears to be substring-based; consider exposing the resolution rule in the response payload (e.g. fees_source='indicative_iit_230000_v1') so the audit trail explains the seed in addition to admin overrides.
test_credentials: N/A - admin endpoints are open per spec
seed_data_creation: Tests trigger a full intelligence batch (POST /api/admin/nirf/intelligence year=2024,category=Engineering) which overwrites nirf_intelligence_scores rows for the 15 Engineering 2024 institutions. The fees-update test PUTs fees=500000 then fees=50000 on a non-IIT-Kanpur record (whichever the leaderboard's #1 non-Kanpur row is) and restores the original fees+source in a finally block. Note: IIT Kanpur (IR-E-I-1075) retains the leftover 100000 admin override from the main agent's manual curl testing — this is by design per the agent_to_agent_context_note and the browser verification used that override (observed 86.8 AAA VFM after a further drop to 75000 in the UI flow).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live API regression for the intelligence feature: /app/backend/tests/test_nirf_intelligence_api.py — run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview-url> pytest backend/tests/test_nirf_intelligence_api.py -v. The fees test restores its target's fees in a finally block, but if the test is interrupted, you may see a stale override; just re-run POST /api/admin/nirf/intelligence to recompute the whole cohort. The frontend 'See How This Was Calculated' breakdown only mounts AFTER the toggle click — when writing Playwright, click how-calculated-{score_key} first then wait_for_selector calc-breakdown-{score_key}. The intel-to-metrics link is rendered in the page header; it is NOT conditional on detail panel state, but it does need the page to be fully mounted ([data-testid='admin-intelligence-page']) before being interactable. The fees-editor success toast is rendered via sonner (bottom-right) and disappears on its own after ~3s, so screenshot it within 2s of the save click.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. One transient observation during testing was that immediately after clicking metrics-to-intelligence and waiting for the URL change, the intel-to-metrics link was not yet present in the DOM — this was a TEST TIMING issue (not an app bug). A subsequent direct-load of /admin/nirf/intelligence and explicit wait_for_selector confirmed the link is always rendered as part of the page header and the navigation round-trip works in both directions.
